scope: bot23 source, params, tests, and documentation only

findings.cause: US admission boundaries were shifted with the London DST regime even when New York and London were in different regimes
findings.correction: Europe/London now governs the European boundary and America/New_York independently governs both US boundaries
findings.regression: 2026 US transition instants and a March EU-US mismatch week

findings.cause: a missing confirmed live position open_time silently fell back to the decision/poll time
findings.correction: the runner retains exact position ownership, blocks entry without inventing a deadline, and restores broker open_time on a later clean sync
findings.current_reachability: live fixed-hold OPEN response with missing open_time
findings.regression: missing fill time is not substituted and later exact sync recovers it

findings.cause: the configuration listed summer and standard block pairs without naming the reference market for each individual boundary
findings.correction: every block start and end now declares fixed_jst, Europe/London, or America/New_York independently; direct close monitoring also preserves a missing fill time as recoverable
findings.regression: spring and autumn EU-US mismatch weeks plus direct missing-fill lifecycle monitoring

findings.cause: the bot23 Compose service mounted the runner but not its two newly separated clock modules
findings.correction: both clock modules are now explicit read-only bot23 volume mounts and covered by a regression
findings.current_reachability: container restart with an image predating the modules

findings.cause: fixed-hold close monitoring first compared the deadline with the host poll clock even though the broker quote clock was documented as authoritative
findings.correction: JST09-11 and JST11-13 fixed-hold deadlines, retry timing, and close eligibility now use the broker quote timestamp; host time is fallback only outside live mode
findings.current_reachability: host clock lag relative to broker quote time
findings.regression: JST11-13 close at broker deadline while host clock is thirty seconds behind

preserved_behavior: JST09-11 entry and fixed hold parameters
JST11-13 entry and 60 minute fixed hold parameter
all eight ownership lanes and magics
fresh quote, spread stabilization, timeout, and market-closed retry

evidence_note.disposition: retained unchanged as a historical noncanonical note; not used as a release manifest
